title: Weather Radar Transceiver — Removal

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Independent Position Determining — Weather Radar Transceiver

abstract: Removal of the weather radar transceiver from the radome bulkhead tray, covering both the magnetron and the solid state standards and the shim stack record that must be taken before the unit is disturbed.

sections.purpose: To remove the weather radar transceiver from the radome bulkhead tray for replacement or for access to the antenna drive behind it.
sections.job_setup_note: The radar must have been de-selected and the aircraft de-powered for at least ten minutes before the radome is opened, so that the transmitter is discharged on the magnetron standard. The radome must be opened and supported clear of the bulkhead. Two persons are needed. The shim stack must be measured and recorded before the unit is removed.
sections.procedure: WARNING: DO NOT OPEN THE RADOME UNTIL THE RADAR HAS BEEN DE-SELECTED AND THE AIRCRAFT HAS BEEN DE-POWERED FOR AT LEAST TEN MINUTES. RADIATED ENERGY IS A HAZARD TO PERSONNEL AND THE MAGNETRON SUPPLY HOLDS A CHARGE. Put the safety barriers in position around the nose. Remove the electrical power and put the warning notices in position. Release the radome latches and open the radome. Install the radome support strut. Measure the shim stack at each of the four tray mounting points and record the values. Disconnect the waveguide at the transceiver flange and fit the protective cap immediately. CAUTION: DO NOT LET THE WAVEGUIDE HANG ON ITS FLANGE. SUPPORT IT ON THE STRAP PROVIDED OR THE FLANGE WILL DISTORT. Disconnect the two electrical connectors at the rear of the unit and fit the caps. Remove the four mounting washers AES311855K5 and AGS393059-2A and keep them with the aircraft if the same unit is to be refitted. Support the transceiver, remove the four mounting bolts and lift the unit clear of the tray. Put the unit in the transit container with the shim record attached.
sections.close_out: Make sure that the waveguide is capped and supported and that all connectors are capped. Make sure that no tools or hardware remain inside the radome. Close the radome if no further work is planned, or leave it supported for the following task. Remove the warning notices and the safety barriers. Record the removal, the serial number and the shim stack values.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Steps 6 and 7 differ between the magnetron and the solid state standard.

safety_precautions: Do not open the radome until the radar has been de-selected and the aircraft de-powered for at least ten minutes.
Put the safety barriers in position around the nose.
Install the radome support strut before any work inside the radome.
